name: Ultimate Finance OS
short_description: The complete Excel operating system to track expenses, manage budgets, analyze cash flow, and grow your net worth.
long_description: Take control of your personal and business finances with the Ultimate Finance OS. A premium, dual-mode (light/dark) spreadsheet engineered for high-performance financial tracking. Designed for individuals, creators, and business owners looking to consolidate their income streams, expense allocations, OKRs, and net worth progress in a single unified dashboard view.
